components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'General Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; background: var(--blue); color: oklch(0.21 0.014 245); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.5) inset, 0 8px 20px -8px oklch(0.6 0.12 216 / 0.7); transform-origin: bottom; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-strong); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scaleX(1.02) scaleY(0.92); transition-duration: 75ms; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-strong); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary .ds-arrow { transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); }

components.css: .ds-flow { position: relative; display: inline-flex; } .ds-flow-ring { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 200ms ease-out; } .ds-flow-ring rect { fill: none; stroke: var(--blue-text); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 6 4; } .ds-flow:hover .ds-flow-ring { opacity: 1; } .ds-flow:hover .ds-flow-ring rect { animation: ds-dash 0.9s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-dash { to { stroke-dashoffset: -10; } } .ds-flow-btn { position: relative; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'General Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); background: var(--sheet-sunk); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); transform-origin: bottom; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), box-shadow 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-flow:hover .ds-flow-btn { background: transparent; box-shadow: none; } .ds-flow-btn:active { transform: scaleY(0.94); transition-duration: 75ms; } .ds-flow-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-strong); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-flow:hover .ds-flow-ring rect { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
A familiar personal portfolio, built so that every surface answers the hand. The structure is the category standard (a sticky header, a hero, selected work, a role history, writing, a footer) and the quality lives in the execution: soft tinted ground, large rounded sheets floating on it, one blue that works as a fill, and per-project colour fields that let each piece of work wear its own identity. Nothing on the page is a concept costume; the craft is in squash-on-press buttons, pointer-following glows, arrows that slide, and tiles that lift.

Density is calm and generous at the section level (96 to 144px between sections) and compact inside tiles and panels. Neutrals are tinted toward the accent hue so ground, sheet and ink read as one family. Dark mode is its own palette with deeper sheets and softer ink, never an inversion.

The site has a confirmed visual rejection on record: concept-driven worlds (railway chart, cut-paper, contact sheet, ikebana) were declined in favour of "normal looking sites, but make it good and interactive". The previous davidsling.in design language does not carry over.
keyCharacteristics: Rounded sheets (40px) and bento tiles (28px) on a cool soft-neutral ground.
One accent, David's blue, used as a fill with ink on it.
Each project owns a colour field for its hero, its signature block, its home card and its "next project" door.
General Sans throughout, semibold headlines with tight negative tracking.
Every clickable element gives tactile feedback; every motion has a reduced-motion path.

rules.name: The Fill-Not-Text Rule
rules.body: Blue is a surface, never a text colour. Text that needs the accent uses `blue-text`; text on blue uses fixed ink.

rules.name: The Field Owns Its Moments Rule
rules.body: A project colour appears only in that project's case hero, its signature block, its home card and the "next project" door that leads to it. Shared frame sections (prose, decisions) stay on ground and sheet.

rules.name: The Dark Is Its Own Palette Rule
rules.body: Dark mode redefines every neutral, every `-text` shade, both shadows and the effect colours. Field fills and blue stay; anything read as text is retuned for the dark ground.

rules.name: The Tracking Scales With Size Rule
rules.body: The bigger the type, the tighter it is: -0.04em for display, -0.03em for headlines, -0.02em for titles, normal for body.

rules.name: The Mono Means Literal Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only for text a machine would read: commands, code, package names. Never for decoration or labels.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Hover Rule
rules.body: Resting tiles sit on `shadow-tile`; hover moves them to `shadow-lift` (eases in over 500ms, out over 200ms) and press squeezes them to 98.5%.

rules.name: The Ring-Not-Border Rule
rules.body: Wells and chips are outlined with a 1px inset or outer box-shadow ring in `line`, not a CSS border. Ruled lists (decisions, the explain panel's fact row) are the exception and use a 1px top border.

rules.name: The Nesting Radius Rule
rules.body: A child's radius is always smaller than its parent's. Never put a 28px tile inside a 24px panel.

dos: Do put ink on blue (fixed ink, `oklch(0.21 0.014 245)`) and use `blue-text` wherever the accent has to be read as text.
Do give every clickable element press feedback: the pill squash (`scale-y 0.92`, 75ms) for buttons, 98.5% for tiles, 90 to 95% for small chips and dots.
Do ease hover-in slowly (500ms) and hover-out quickly (200ms) on the expo curve `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`.
Do mark travelling or tilting elements `data-motion="travel"` so reduced motion strips transform and keeps colour, opacity and shadow feedback.
Do step radii down as containers nest (40, 32, 28, 24, 16, 12).
Do keep a project's field colour to its hero, signature block, home card and next-project door.
Do show real or live media in project frames (video, a live pendulum, the real npm package running).
donts: Don't put white text on David's blue.
Don't use tracked uppercase eyebrows or kickers; labels are sentence case at 0.76 to 0.85rem in ink-3.
Don't invert the light palette for dark mode; retune neutrals, `-text` shades and shadows.
Don't use the `cf-effect-*` colours outside the cmd-facts explain panel.
Don't use monospace for anything a machine wouldn't read.
Don't reintroduce the previous davidsling.in design language or a concept-driven world.
